name: Chipiona (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Chipiona (a tower on yellow above waves, inscribed CAEPIONIS TURRIS).
history: Municipal flag of Chipiona; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Chipiona arms — tower above waves, inscribed CAEPIONIS TURRIS
